$comment: Server-owned retrieval configuration. Versioned in the repository on
purpose: these values decide which evidence an answer may rest on, so
changing them is a reviewable diff rather than a runtime flag. No client
Retrieval itself is implemented in Phase 17.1b; this file is the contract
it will load, and is validated in 17.1a so the shape cannot drift.
title_weight and heading_weight scale field-aware matching against the
document title and heading path. Zero reproduces pure body BM25 exactly;
Set by the published 17.1b calibration grid: heading_weight 0.25 is the
smallest non-zero combination reaching recall@5 >= 85% without reducing
recall@1 or recall@3. title_weight stays 0.0 because no title weighting
improved on it. These weights are FITTED to a 17-question calibration
set and are not evidence of generalisation.
minimum_score is a NO-SIGNAL FLOOR only. Measurement showed BM25 scores
cannot separate in-scope from out-of-scope questions, so genuine
insufficient-evidence refusal belongs to generation in Phase 17.1c.
